differences.a_observable: Tight camera framing on the central card with shallow depth of field blurring the background.
differences.b_observable: Wider camera framing with deep depth of field keeping background elements sharp.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and enable depth of field.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette with distinct corner light falloff.
differences.b_observable: Flat, uniform lighting across the frame with no vignette.

differences.a_observable: Brushed metal texture on the right-side background panel.
differences.b_observable: Flat, untextured grey material on the background panel.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal texture map.

differences.a_observable: High contrast with deep shadows and soft contact shadows under the cards.
differences.b_observable: Low contrast with flat lighting and barely visible shadows.
differences.fix: Adjust lighting to increase contrast and shadow depth.

json.highest_impact_fix: Match the camera framing, depth of field, and high-contrast lighting of the reference video.
